16 November 2026 update: Full original scientific review passed for both the standard restricted regular wreath-product consequence and the exact planar L2/P2 infima. The credited group-algebra and sharp Fourier input proofs, exact Hopfian embedding, compact duality and continuous/Schwartz interfaces were substantively checked; current finite integral evidence and one fresh scalar reproduction support their stated bounds. No repair, narrowing or speculative follow-up was needed. The deductions remain derivative, with no human peer review, formal-proof, priority, all-dimensional or triangle-optimizer-attainment claim. Page preparation remains pending; canonical stays blank. Evidence: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/a6f42238754b67083e126ef3982711068b70f186/research_website_catalogue_20261024/papers/23203143/reviews/root/ROOT_REVIEW.md

No final original-claim disposition or public page is approved. The exact restricted regular wreath product and stated planar Schwartz-program scope are being checked separately. values.formattedValue:
16 November 2026 update: The full original model-specific threshold and its complete order-32 random-cone construction passed root and independent scope/adversarial review without repair or narrowing. The least dyadic order is 32 for the unchanged seven-extra squared-turn model; the construction remains existential. Embedding and characteristic-two right-module consequences were checked, with substantive OpenAI construction inputs and classical mechanisms credited. Current finite parameter and incidence checks support their stated interfaces; no selected matching, target multiplication, first-priority, formal-proof or human-review certificate is claimed. Private page preparation is underway; canonical stays blank. No qualifying follow-up. Evidence: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/656600a20cc97b28ee87986493917eb098ca2faf/research_website_catalogue_20261024/papers/23205181/reviews/root/ROOT_REVIEW.md

Earlier inventory note:
16 November 2026 update: Full manuscript review has begun. Two independent scope/adversarial families read the complete published manuscript and fresh PDF pages, wrote their own derivations and sealed source-first INITIAL records before supporting code, old audits and outside proofs. Root also read the whole original, with prior exposure to the shared group-algebra input explicitly disclosed. Exact model-specific threshold, order-32 construction, embedding and module claims remain under review. No scientific pass or public page is approved; originals are unchanged and canonical stays blank. values.formattedValue:
16 November 2026 update: The full original graph-recovery theorem passed root and independent scope/adversarial review without repair or narrowing. It concerns literal partitions of the same fixed-label full configuration space, including collisions, for simple graphs and positive n,d. The positive singleton-support and continuous nonedge-transport proof supplies the universal result; exact finite checks corroborate its formulas. The native forest example shows that arbitrary ambient equivalence is a different, false extension. Prior collision/collinear credit and specific journal-versus-preprint access limits are retained; no unwritten-intent, priority, human-review or formal-proof claim. Private page preparation is underway; canonical stays blank. No qualifying follow-up. Evidence: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/656600a20cc97b28ee87986493917eb098ca2faf/research_website_catalogue_20261024/papers/23331540/reviews/root/ROOT_REVIEW.md

Earlier inventory note:
16 November 2026 update: Full manuscript review has begun. Both independent families sealed complete source-first readings and derivations before supporting code, old audits and outside proofs. Root checked the complete original, its exact fixed-label/full-collision comparison and one unchanged exact-rational collision-witness program; that run passed. The written proof supplies universal and connectedness claims; finite tests do not decide historical intent or novelty. Supporting and independent reviews remain pending. No scientific pass or public page is approved; canonical stays blank. Evidence: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/a6f42238754b67083e126ef3982711068b70f186/research_website_catalogue_20261024/papers/23331540/reviews/root/INITIAL_SEAL.json
